layer1_memory_question_unwrapped.prompt: How does Clover's per-layer cache partition fix flat hit rates?
layer1_memory_question_unwrapped.reply: Clover's per-layer cache partition splits the working set into separate caches for each layer, so a single layer's data is kept in its own cache. This means that when a request accesses data from one layer, it can be served directly from that layer's dedicated cache without needing to search across all layers. As a result, flat hit rates improve because the majority of requests hit within their own layer's cache instead of requiring cross-layer lookups.
